svg.metadata: Territory c.1025, hand-adjusted using the supplied c.1020 reference and the historical extent under Basil II. Original 565 map terrain and geographical base preserved; new territory is a grouped, editable vector layer. Source map 1025 cited: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Map_Byzantine_Empire_1025-en.svg
